title: Redstone Importance
description: This mod(made with MCreator) adds a few redstone stuff
body:
Redstone Importance adds a new set of craftable Redstone tools to Minecraft.

This mod introduces:

A Redstone Sword

A Redstone Pickaxe

A Redstone Axe

A Redstone Hoe

Redstone Ingots are crafted by smelting Redstone Dust in a furnace. These ingots are then combined with sticks to create Redstone tools.

Redstone tools are designed to take advantage of mining out large areas, providing an easily renewable alternative to early-game tools. They offer balanced stats between stone and iron, making them useful for progression without being overpowered.

This mod is made with MCreator and is intended to be lightweight and simple.
